# A test drives a select on every target: `c.pick.change("Banana")` chooses
# the choice labeled Banana, which the `:value` binding writes back and the
# program's @change hears, once -- including where the choices are state that
# arrives after the select is built, and through an instance.
#
# Each target's select is a control a test chooses through, as a user does:
# html's <select>, fyne's Select, gtk4's GtkDropDown (the invoker selects the
# label, which notifies), bubbletea's tui.Select (a list whose cursor is the
# choice), android's SnglSelect (a field a label is typed into, with a menu of
# text a test sets to a label) and the interpreter's own.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component chooser ui.node {
    var fruits list[string] = []
    var chosen = "Apple"
    var picked = ""
    var changes = 0

    ui.button #fill(text="Fill", @click { fruits = ["Apple", "Banana", "Cherry"] })
    ui.select #pick(:value=chosen, @change(v) {
        picked = v
        changes += 1
    }) {
        for var f = fruits {
            ui.choice(label=f)
        }
    }
    ui.text(value=chosen)
}

component wrapped ui.node {
    chooser #inner()
}

func testChangePicksTheChoiceNamed(t test.Test, c chooser) {
    c.fill.click()
    c.pick.change("Banana")
    t.assert(c.picked == "Banana")
    t.assert(c.chosen == "Banana")
    t.assert(c.changes == 1)
}

func testChangeReachesThroughAnInstance(t test.Test, c wrapped) {
    c.inner.fill.click()
    c.inner.pick.change("Cherry")
    t.assert(c.inner.picked == "Cherry")
    t.assert(c.inner.chosen == "Cherry")
}
